name: University of Progress
source:
College is the most important chapter of your life. It's an opportunity to meet new people. To find yourself. To learn new things.

Too bad you're playing as Millard Wilson, a bitter young man who has zero patience with most people. 

University of Progress is a choice-driven visual novel. Actually choice-driven. There's literally a school shooting ending and that's not even the worst one. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4312620/University_of_Progress/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
大学是你人生中最重要的篇章——它是结识新朋友、找寻自我、学习新事物的宝贵机会。

只可惜你扮演的是米勒德·威尔逊——一个对绝大多数人都毫无耐心的愤世青年。

《进步大学》（University of Progress）是一款选择驱动型视觉小说——货真价实的选择驱动。游戏里甚至真有一条校园枪击结局，而那都还算不上最糟糕的一个结局。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4312620/University_of_Progress/]Steam[/url]]
